title: Calendar and events
summary: The SkyBlock calendar runs on Hypixel's own clock, so the date here is the date on Hypixel. A day lasts 20 minutes, and the year has twelve months of festivals.

s.x: SkyBlock has its own calendar, and it runs on
Hypixel's clock
: the date in SkyRPG is the same as the date on Hypixel at that moment.
The months are
Early Spring, Spring, Late Spring, Early Summer, Summer, Late Summer, Early Autumn, Autumn, Late Autumn, Early Winter, Winter
and
Late Winter
. Year 1 began on June 11, 2019.
The sky follows the calendar: at 6am on the SkyBlock clock the sun comes up, and at 7pm night falls.
The
SkyBlock sidebar
on the right of your screen shows, from the top:
the real date;
the SkyBlock date ("Late Summer 12th");
the time, with ☀ by day or ☽ by night;
where you are (⏣ Your Island, ⏣ Hub, or someone else's island);
your
purse
Move it, resize it or hide it in the HUD editor (
K, Settings, HUD, Edit HUD layout
Open the K menu and choose
Calendar and Events
. It shows:
today's SkyBlock date and time, and how long until the next day;
all twelve months, with their events (hover a month for details); the current month has a bar showing how far through it you are;
Coming up
: the next events, with a countdown to each, or how long one that's running has left.

rows.x: All spring: Early Spring 1st to Late Spring 31st
Early Summer 1st to 3rd, and Early Winter 1st to 3rd
Every third day, from the 2nd (on the real clock, every hour at :15)

s.x: The calendar already shows these events. Each one starts working in game when its system arrives (the Spooky Festival with its mobs and candy, Jacob's contests with the Garden, and so on).
